subject: Your not the only one who feels that way
author: ZombieTron
body:
From the comments I have read around the interwebs it seems like the majority of the Burnout community is less than impressed.

It seems similar to the XBLA titles that I play more regularly then I play Burnout now anyway, so I am really looking forward to playing an XBLA game with a Burnout spin on it.

Being a download only game, it was never going to WOW like a disc game could. The only thing left to judge this on will be the price.

I hope it will suit everyones pocket, maybe if the price point is right (see what I did there, I can make gameshow references too!) the naysayers will buy it anyway and find they actually have fun playing the game.

I really like that it is stepping away from realism and embracing being a video game! 👍
